title: [Deduction in respect of educational expenses in certain cases]
text:
80F. [Deduction in respect of educational expenses in certain cases].—Omitted by the Finance

_Act, 1985 (32 of 1985), s. 17 (w.e.f. 1-4-1986). Before omission by Act 3 of 1989, s. 95 it was ins. by Act 4_
_of 1988, s. 24 (w.e.f. 1-4-1989)._

80FF. [Deduction in respect of expenses on higher education in certain cases].—Omitted by the

_Finance (No. 2) Act, 1980 (44 of 1980), s. 14 (w.e.f. 1-4-1981). Earlier inserted by Act 25 of 1975 s. 11_
(w.e.f. 1-4-1976).
